summary_for_children: Al-Anbiya means The Prophets. It reminds us that the heavens and the earth were made by Allah, and tells briefly of many prophets: Ibrahim and the fire, Dawud and Sulayman, Ayyub, Yunus, Zakariyya and others, who all called to worship Allah alone.
environment_concept: Rooms of signs: a spring (21:30), an empty ring of stones where the fire was made cool (21:69; no fire or person is shown), mountains with birds (21:79), a sail full of wind (21:81) and a dark sea at night (21:87).
architecture_and_scenery: Colonnade of plain stone rooms, each with a single symbolic object: a cooled fire pit, mountains and birds, a wind-driven sail, a whale-dark sea.

palette.lighting: Shifting daylight with a slow-orbiting sun and moon above the gallery

areas.name: Joined Heavens and Earth
areas.description: A dome where sky and land slowly part and water appears.

areas.name: Room of the Cool Fire
areas.description: A fire pit glowing cool blue; no person is shown.

areas.name: Room of Mountains and Birds
areas.description: Hills and birds that seem to join in glorifying Allah.

areas.name: Room of the Wind
areas.description: A sail filled by a strong steady wind.

areas.name: Room of the Darknesses
areas.description: Layered darkness of night, sea and the deep, with one ayah lit.

activities.name: The orbits
activities.description: Find four bright lights floating over the spring.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Prophet timeline
activities.description: Place each room's object in the order the surah mentions it.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Words of Yunus
activities.description: Read 21:87 aloud to brighten the darkened room (the prophet is not shown).
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

narration_plan: Each room opens with its ayahs; the narrator explains, never speaking as a prophet.
learning_objectives: Explain the shared message of all prophets

status.playable_environment: first version built: a composed world (birds, mountain, sea, ships, spring, stones) with 1 hands-on activity in the scene
status.testing: not tested yet: written and type-checked, not yet checked on screen

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.

unique_world.tier: conceptual for the new engine (an older composed scene exists; not validated as unique)
